en: Removed the blanket prohibition on sending, publishing and payment from CLI execution instructions. Actions follow the user’s task authorization; subscription authentication and API-key isolation remain in place.
The execution log now starts collapsed when its panel is opened. Click the header to expand or collapse the records.
All nine README languages now include a support link that opens the matching language on the author’s website.
zh: 取消 CLI 执行提示中“不发送、不发布、不付费”的统一限制，相关操作按用户对任务的授权执行；保留订阅认证与 API Key 隔离。
执行记录面板打开时默认收起，点击标题即可展开或收起记录。
九种语言的 README 均加入打赏链接，打开作者网站时对应显示该语言。
